website.note: Pipeline page lists nelitolimod (SD-101) across multiple liver/pancreatic cancer indications; readouts of three Phase 1 PERIO studies expected in 2026.

pipeline.modality: Synthetic single-stranded oligonucleotide; class C TLR9 agonist
pipeline.license_origin: Acquired worldwide rights from Dynavax Technologies (2020 Asset Purchase Agreement)

indications.trial_design: Phase 1 study of pressure-enabled intrapancreatic delivery (PEDD/PRVI) of nelitolimod with anti-PD-1 checkpoint blockade in locally advanced PDAC
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (sponsor-led; data readout expected 2026)
key_milestones: Subsequent indication selection and partnering discussions planned post-readout

commercial_product.name: TriNav Infusion System (and broader TriNav device portfolio)
commercial_product.category: FDA-cleared pressure-enabled drug delivery (PEDD) microcatheter for hepatic arterial infusion
commercial_product.note: Provides current commercial revenue; used clinically for delivery of standard-of-care therapeutics into liver tumors.
